return_summary.uncertainty: Bonferroni normal intervals for four predeclared aggregate contrasts, using independent fresh rounds or 100-round continuous blocks. Other contrasts/scenarios are exploratory.
return_summary.deviation: Original action-only batch parity failed. All Laya return policies use the exact serving SDK; no weights, calibration, selection, seeds, counts, or deadline changed. Original failure evidence is retained.

visited-minus-control.uncertainty: Paired whole-game bootstrap, 2000 replicates; conditions on approximate teacher labels. Stratum intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

visited-minus-incumbent.uncertainty: Paired whole-game bootstrap, 2000 replicates; conditions on approximate teacher labels. Stratum intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

control-minus-incumbent.uncertainty: Paired whole-game bootstrap, 2000 replicates; conditions on approximate teacher labels. Stratum intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

fresh.inference: Fixed equal-weight strata; normal 95% intervals over independent rounds or 100-round blocks. Scenario intervals are exploratory, without multiplicity correction.
fresh.pairing: Identical initial RNG seeds per unit; different actions can diverge subsequent trajectories.
fresh.limitations: The basic policy is a multi-deck heuristic. Fixed wagers, no insurance; these simulator results do not establish optimality or real-world profitability.

continuous.inference: Fixed equal-weight strata; normal 95% intervals over independent rounds or 100-round blocks. Scenario intervals are exploratory, without multiplicity correction.
continuous.pairing: Identical initial RNG seeds per unit; different actions can diverge subsequent trajectories.
continuous.limitations: The basic policy is a multi-deck heuristic. Fixed wagers, no insurance; these simulator results do not establish optimality or real-world profitability.

interpretation: The model-visited arm won the frozen selection rule, but the fixed final evaluation did not resolve a return or reference-regret improvement over the incumbent/control. Four planned return contrasts use familywise intervals; comparisons with basic and scenario breakdowns are exploratory. No model promotion or publication.
unit_count_scope: Policy-unit records count all four policies. Policies share paired seeds; do not treat 404000 records as independent between-policy samples. Continuous units each contain 100 correlated rounds.
